blocks.text: Sheila Mangubat, a Filipina cast member of the reality dating series “90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days,” has died at the age of 35. Her former fiancé, David Dangerfield, announced her death in an Instagram post on Sunday, Nov. 22, saying she passed away in the Philippines. “It breaks my heart to share the news from her family that Sheila passed away on Saturday in the Philippines,” Dangerfield wrote. “I am devastated and still trying to process this loss. Please keep her son, her family, and me in your prayers. Thank you for all your love and support,” he concluded. […]... Keep on reading: ‘90 Day Fiancé’ Filipina star Sheila Mangubat dies at 35
